title: ChargePoint Home Flex dwnldlogsm tar Command Injection Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-131814)
description: CVE-2026-131814 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. It arises from improper validation of user-supplied input in the tar function used by the dwnldlogsm component, allowing command injection. Exploitation requires prior ability to execute low-privileged code on the device. Successful exploitation can lead to arbitrary code execution with root privileges.
